text:
Dina: Heads-up — kickoff for Silverline->Redwood POC. Need parity checklist + security Q answered by EOD. Staging creds coming in ~2h. Anyone able to triage sync later today?

Omar: On it. Can you paste a representative Silverline request/response and the header requirements? Streaming vs non-streaming differences?

Dina: Minimal samples below. They expect `X-SL-Tenant` header and `model=sl-v2` query param. Also they return `trace_id` and `deterministic_seed` in responses.
```
POST /v1/generate?model=sl-v2
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <key>, X-SL-Tenant: acct-123
Body: {"prompt":"Summarize this...","max_tokens":256}

Response:
{
  "id":"r_abc","trace_id":"t-987","choices":[{"text":"...","flags":[]}] ,"usage":{"prompt_tokens":12,"completion_tokens":34}
}
```

Liam: Eng note: we don't emit `deterministic_seed` or `flags` currently. We can implement a lightweight facade to preserve/synthesize fields so customer sees parity. Two mapping caveats: `choices[].flags` vs our `annotations` and `usage` calc (they count tokens slightly differently).

Omar: For POC plan: 1) passthrough `X-SL-Tenant` 2) preserve `trace_id` 3) add a `facade.usage_mode=sl-normalize` to match their billing math. Need a canary route in staging.

Teja: Security Qs to confirm: customer requires KMS-managed keys for any customer-supplied keys, idempotency header support, SOC2 evidence, IP allowlist, and ability to produce request/response audit logs. Who owns the questionnaire?

Dina: Teja please own the security questionnaire + KMS mapping. Liam can you own the facade implementation? Omar own pricing/terms ask. I'll loop in Legal for NDA/DPA.

Liam: Quick tech detail — tokenization delta: Silverline counts trailing newlines as tokens differently which shifts `usage`. Proposed approach: normalization step before tokenization: `normalize_newlines=true`. Perf hit minimal (~1-2ms per request).

Omar: Pricing note: they'll ask for per-token parity during pilot. Suggest we bill normalized tokens for POC and revisit on commit. I'll draft a pilot quote: POC credit + 20% pilot discount. Dina can you confirm?

Dina: :thumbsup: I can approve POC credit + 20% pilot discount. NDA + DPA required before live staging.

Teja: Security owner: Teja. Will need access to staging evidence: logs, config, role lists. @deploy-bot can you stand up a staging VPC with a KMS key named `poctest-silverline` and an allowlist?

deploy-bot: Staging VPC provisioned: vpc-pt-42. KMS key `poctest-silverline` created and granted to `eng-team`. Temporary creds will be posted to the secure channel in ~2h.

Liam: For streaming differences: Silverline uses `delta_text` frames (they send {"delta_text":"hi"} frames). We'll translate to Redwood streaming events: `{event: "content", data: "hi"}`. Small mapping snippet below.
```js
// facade mapping (pseudo)
if (frame.delta_text) emit({event:'content',data:frame.delta_text});
if (resp.trace_id) resp.headers['X-Orig-Trace'] = resp.trace_id;
// usage: run normalize_tokenizer(input, {normalize_newlines:true}) before counting
```

Omar: Timeline proposal: sync 10:00am tomorrow, security questionnaire draft by tomorrow 12:00, facade PR by EOD tomorrow, staging smoke test after legal signs NDA. Any blockers?

Teja: One blocker: customer legal requests mTLS for pilot. Need to confirm hosted support; if we can't, fallback will be Redwood Dedicated. Please flag asap.

Dina: Noted. Omar, flag mTLS requirement in the customer facing doc and escalate to Enterprise Ops if needed.

Omar: Will do — adding to the risk section of the POC plan.

Liam: I'll open the PR once staging VPC creds arrive and include the normalization flag behind a feature toggle.

Dina: Great — thanks team. We'll reconvene tomorrow AM. :rocket:
